addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.description: EVM addresses to screen (0x..., 40 hex chars). Up to 1000 per run. An invalid entry returns an explanatory record instead of failing the run — you are not charged for it.

chain.title: Chain
chain.description: Which chain to read on-chain signals (contract reads, wallet tx history) from. OFAC/scam-list matching is address-based and applies regardless of chain.
